'Weekly 9<21, LH/LL: a bounce, not a leader.' This stands on my own tests: the weekly frame is broken (C21, house rule), `mp` 55.0 FADING/DECELERATING and `pipe_rank` 42.6 say no trend path, and `subcomponents.structure.wk_score` 5.0 agrees. `subcomponents.flow.cmf` 0.51 alone is not a trend. Conceded; I am OPPOSE.

'ma50 under ma200; 15.5% over swing high is chase.' My author names no 50 or 200-day average (C1), so that template is not my test; extension above the averages is not a fault in the position system (C26). W 9>21 HH/HL, D HH/HL; `subcomponents.structure.wk_score` 15.0, `mp` 96.0. My caution stays thin COM, `subcomponents.flow.cmf` 0.06.

'accum_score 0.0, day_vol 0.84: no institutional demand.' My fund-flow test is COM above zero (C28): `subcomponents.flow.cmf` 0.17 passes. Accumulation acceleration is not my test; it is a caution I name. D HH/HL 3.2% over the swing high is a fresh break; `subcomponents.structure.rs_accel` 10.01 lead widening.

'elder 7.0 after 10, green vanishing on last bar.' My exit is a red candle or a close under support (C14). Daily last bar is green, D HH/HL, `elder` 7.0 still over its floor with `sc_m_gates` True. H1 red under EMA9 is a ripple I manage, not a sell (C7). I move to WAIT for the buy stop to be taken.

'base_score 5.0 thin, 24.4% past the swing high.' Base credit and distance past the pivot are not position-system tests; the break above resistance is the signal (C26). W HH/HL, D HH/HL, daily bar green. `mp` 100.0 and `subcomponents.structure.wk_score` 15.0 hold. My own caution is COM, `subcomponents.flow.cmf` 0.07.
